descriptionChirho: Proper masculine name meaning 'Yahweh has heard' (Hebrew שְׁמַעְיָה / שְׁמַעְיָהוּ, short and long theophoric forms), referring to multiple individuals across the Hebrew Bible: (1) the prophet in Rehoboam's time who forbade civil war (1 Kgs 12:22; 2 Chr 11:2, 12:5-15), (2) Levites and priests in genealogical and service lists (1 Chr 3:22, 4:37, 5:4, 9:14-16, 15:8-11, 24:6, 26:4-7), (3) a Levitical teacher under Jehoshaphat (2 Chr 17:8), (4) various returnees from exile (Ezra 8:16; Neh 12:18), and (5) the false prophet Shemaiah the Nehelamite condemned by Jeremiah (Jer 26:20, 29:24-32, 36:12). Cross-linguistically uniform as a proper name: Arabic شَمَعْيَا, German Schemaja, Korean 스마야/셰마야, Spanish Semaias, Hindi शमैयाह/शमायाह, French Schemaeja. The auto-clusters split by book provenance and orthographic variant (with/without final waw) but represent a single onomastic entry.
